verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a first-party API reference stating that the PlanetScale API lets you manage databases programmatically. Service tokens provide headless authentication. Beyond that one-line statement, the pack shows little of the API surface, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: detailed endpoint coverage showing which operations the API exposes, a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents driving the REST API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The PlanetScale API allows you to manage your PlanetScale databases programmatically.
You can now show a single service token by ID.
